podcast: Artificial Intelligence in Banking And Finance

11428edcd2.q: How did Citigroup reduce technology vendor spending by 30% year-on-year using AI coding tools?
11428edcd2.a: Citigroup reported that 14,000 engineers were using Devon, its principal agentic coding tool, on its October 13th earnings call. Management linked the decision to bring more work in-house with a 30% year-on-year reduction in technology vendor spending. Engineers use an agent to undertake more development internally, and some work previously purchased from vendors moves back into the bank.

c0ef506686.q: What are the differences between Bank of America's approved, live, and fully deployed AI use cases?
c0ef506686.a: Bank of America's July results distinguish more than 300 approved AI and machine learning use cases, 114 live generative AI use cases, and 34 fully deployed cases. Approval indicates a case has passed an internal decision point. A live capability can already serve users while rollout continues. Full deployment describes a later stage.

6dfea457d3.q: How much time does TD Bank's AI agent reduce for personal mortgage preparation?
6dfea457d3.a: TD Bank Group reports that all new personal mortgages pass through an agentic preparation process that scans client documents, extracts information, calculates income, checks policy requirements and consent, and searches for discrepancies. Work previously averaging 15 hours per client could take about three minutes.

27a707271d.q: What percentage reduction in alert review time does FIS AML Investigations agent project for Amalgamated Banks?
27a707271d.a: Amalgamated Banks, in its October 15th release, describes its work as design partner for the FIS AML Investigations agent. The bank projects a reduction of more than 90% in initial alert review time and approximately 98% in deeper case investigation time, based on its current workflows and the agent's capabilities.
